name: Pulseform
summary: An original rhythm-driven platformer built in Godot 4 — a glowing runner that jumps to a synthesized beat. All assets, music and branding are generated in code, nothing imported.
notes: Not a web app, so there's no dashboard/port to launch from the hub. To play: open this folder in Godot 4.4+ (Import the project.godot) and press F5. Everything is constructed in GDScript — the only non-code asset is icon.svg. Music and sound are synthesized at runtime, so the first time a track starts there is a brief one-time generation hitch while it renders the PCM.
